stem: Adil measures $\angle AOB$ in the diagram. The marked size is $135^{\circ}$.

options.text: Call it acute, treating $135^{\circ}$ as less than $90^{\circ}$.
First study the decorative history of angle names before classifying $135^{\circ}$.
It is "$135$", because that numeral is printed largest in the diagram.

teacher.key_rationale: Obtuse means greater than 90° and less than 180°. Calling 135° acute omits the size bands. Decorative history is outside the classification. Picking the printed numeral alone is surface capture.
